entities.summary: Hernán "Pancho" Emilio Jasen Cicarelli is an Argentine-Italian former professional basketball player. Born in Bahía Blanca, Argentina, and standing at a height of 6'6 1⁄2" tall, he played mainly at the small forward position, but he could also play at the shooting guard position.
